Roofing systems

The membranes and shingles we install

Pick a system to see how it's built, how it's installed and why you'd choose it.

SBS Modified Bitumen

SBS (Styrene Butadiene Styrene) is an elastomeric additive to asphalt that when cooled exhibits rubber-like properties. A 2-ply system: two layers of membrane bonded together with hot asphalt or a propane torch, creating a monolithic waterproof membrane.

  • Superior waterproofing
  • UV resistance
  • Long-term durability
  • Cap sheet granules in a variety of colours
Roof assemblySBS

Installation methods

MethodHow it worksBest for
Mechanically fastened base sheet1st ply base sheet fastened to the substrate with specialized screws and plates.Most cost effective
Cap sheet2nd ply embedded with mineral granules to reflect UV rays, heat welded to the base sheet by propane torch.
Fully adhered base sheetBase sheet adhered to the substrate using adhesives or hot asphalt; cap sheet torch welded on top.

Roofing questions, answered

Yes. Platinum Roofing specializes in Commercial Roofing, Flat Roofing, Low Sloped Roofing and Residential Roofing, with over 30 years of roofing experience.

It depends on your building. We install SBS, EPDM and TPO (plus BUR), and with our experience and knowledge we help you choose the correct membrane type for your flat or low-sloped roof.

SBS is a 2-ply modified bitumen system torch or asphalt bonded into a monolithic waterproof membrane. EPDM is a durable synthetic rubber membrane with taped or glued seams. TPO is a flame retardant, UV resistant thermoplastic with hot-air welded seams that can go over existing BUR or metal roofs.

We provide 2 to 15 years of workmanship warranty to all our clients depending on the work. Commercial flat roofing comes with a written 10 year warranty; residential shingle roofs include a full coverage 10 yr workmanship warranty plus the manufacturer's limited lifetime warranty. EPDM roofing is available with up to 30 years warranty.

Yes. Call Calgary's Flat Roof Specialists for your free inspection. Our experienced inspector can assess your roof and build a cost effective action plan, including preventative maintenance.

We provide both cost effective roof repair and roof replacement solutions. After a free inspection we'll explain the options so you can choose the right one for your building and budget.

Deck inspection and replacement of rotten deck, 3' ice and water barrier at eaves, valleys, chimneys and skylights, underlayment, metal drip edge, starter strip, shingles with matching ridge cap, and full debris removal.
